the_thing_worth_reading_twice: Both of this session's findings are the same shape, and it is not the shape the repository has been watching for. check-wiring catches a file nobody reads and a script nothing runs. Neither of these was unwired: compute-eta was read by everything, and eta-gate was run by every lap. They were wired to CONSTANTS. A ternary whose branches are identical, and a counter that can only reset via an event it forbids, both pass every structural check while making the system incapable of the thing it exists to do. The way both were found was the same and is cheap: feed the machine a situation in which it MUST give a different answer, and see whether it does. A test that cannot fail proves nothing — and neither does a metric that cannot move.
